account-care.h2.0: A pace designed to look after your account
account-care.p.0: Pautia avoids abrupt or repetitive sending patterns. You can adjust how it responds while keeping control of the conversation.
account-care.p.1: Answer during your working day or pick another schedule. Being available all day is an option, not a requirement.
account-care.p.2: Set pauses before reading, replying and sending, with small variations so the timing isn't identical every time.
account-care.p.3: Turn on read receipts and a typing indicator before each reply.
account-care.p.4: Prepare several ways to say the same thing; Pautia chooses among them without inventing the content.
account-care.p.5: Set how much each account can reply and how often an action can be repeated for the same person.
account-care.p.6: The agent responds to conversations your customers started. It does not run mass campaigns on its own.
account-care.plans-note.0: These measures help reduce risk, but no automation can guarantee that an account will never be restricted.
faq.a.0: How we care for your account
faq.faq-answer.0: No. You connect the number you already use, personal or business, and you can connect more than one on a larger plan.
faq.faq-answer.1: Some WhatsApp accounts require a confirmation on the phone every time a new device connects. If yours does, we tell you before you buy, and if it turns out the account cannot be automated, we tell you that too.
faq.faq-answer.2: No. You review the flow and its answers before activating it. AI chooses from the options you approved; it doesn't write new replies to send to your customers.
faq.faq-answer.3: Yes. You can edit the flow, the data and the hours in your account, try the changes and publish them. Some settings require an agent restart; Pautia tells you before you make the change.
faq.faq-answer.4: Every account lives isolated from the others: what happens in one never mixes with another. And this page uses no cookies and no trackers.
faq.faq-answer.5: No. Your team builds and adjusts the flow in a visual editor. Importing chats is optional: if you authorize it, Pautia suggests a first draft; otherwise you build it from scratch with the same tools.
faq.faq-answer.6: No tool can promise that won't happen. Pautia lets you set delays, reply variants and sending limits, and avoids unsolicited mass messages to help reduce the risk.

faq.summary.1: What if my account asks for extra verification?
faq.summary.2: Can the AI send whatever it wants?
faq.summary.3: Can I change prices or hours without anything going down?
faq.summary.5: Do I need to know how to code?

features.h3.1: It replies with what you wrote
features.h3.2: A conversation with its own rhythm
features.h3.3: Nobody gets a message they didn't ask for
features.h3.6: A head start, if you want one
features.h3.7: You see it before it goes out
features.h3.8: You change it whenever you want
features.p.0: Choose when it responds: just during business hours, on a special schedule or all day, if that suits your business.
features.p.1: You prepare the answers and their variants. Pautia chooses among them based on each question without writing new replies.
features.p.2: Set the delays, read receipts and typing indicator so it doesn't answer everything at once.
features.p.3: Pautia only answers whoever writes to you. It never starts bulk conversations or promotions on its own.
features.p.4: Calendar, stock or whatever system you use: Pautia looks up your data and replies with what it gets back.
features.p.5: Connect your current WhatsApp account: customers keep writing to the number they already know.
features.p.6: If you import history, AI finds recurring topics and suggests answers and actions. Without importing, you can build the flow from scratch.
features.p.7: The flow is a map your team can build or edit without coding, then test with simulated conversations before activating the agent.
features.p.8: A price, an opening hour, a new answer. You change it and it keeps working, without waiting for somebody else to do it for you.
how-t.h2.0: From your number to your own agent, in three steps
how.p.0: Link the number your business already uses. Importing conversations is optional: if you authorize it, AI suggests answers and actions from them.
how.p.1: Your team can start from that suggestion or build the flow from scratch in the visual editor, without coding. Adjust answers, connect your services and test conversations before publishing.
how.p.2: Nothing responds until the business activates it. Then AI follows the approved flow to reply or act on each message, during the chosen hours.

no-black-box-t.h2.0: AI suggests. You decide what it can do.
no-black-box.h3.0: It chooses from options you approved
no-black-box.p.0: Pautia uses AI to understand what each person needs. But your support flow defines the answers, the actions and the boundaries.
no-black-box.p.1: It recognizes the intent and follows the path you configured: it replies with your words or asks a connected service for the information.
no-black-box.p.2: AI decides which path to follow and which action to use, but replies with text you approved and real data from your services.
page.title.0: Pautia — An agent for your business's WhatsApp
plans-t.h2.0: Pick the plan you need today
plans.dd.0: Storage keeps the text of the messages only. We do not store images, audio, video or any other media file.
plans.dd.1: When storage fills up, you export your messages and delete them to make room for the new ones. The capacity is small on purpose; the history is yours and it leaves with you.
plans.li.0: You connect the WhatsApp number you already use, with a QR.
plans.li.1: AI suggests a flow from your history, if you choose to import it.
plans.li.2: You review the answers, actions and hours before turning it on.
plans.li.3: Each account keeps its conversations separate from everyone else's.
plans.p.0: Proposed prices in USD. Pick the size that fits your business.
plans.plan-pitch.3: For very large companies. Everything in Plus, plus an adaptation and a price entirely tailored to your business.
plans.plans-note.0: A concurrent agent is one that can be answering at that moment; a declared one is what you define and keep ready. You can declare more than you run, and turn them on in shifts.
plans.plans-note.1: Limits count outgoing messages, not conversations. When the maximum is reached, the agent stops sending replies until capacity is available.
problem-t.h2.0: Start with your chats. Or start from scratch.
problem.lede.0: If you import conversations, Pautia uses AI to suggest a support flow with answers and actions based on your business. If they contain sensitive information or you prefer not to share them, you can build the same flow from scratch in the visual editor, without coding.
problem.say.0: Importing history is your business's decision.
problem.say.1: Without importing, you keep every tool in the editor.
problem.say.2: The difference is where you begin, not what the agent can do.
security.dd.0: Every account lives in its own space, isolated from the others. One customer's conversations never mix with another's.
security.dd.1: This page uses no cookies, no trackers and no third-party scripts. You can read it with external connections blocked.
usecases.p.0: Dentists, clinics, salons and workshops: it checks availability and confirms appointments when you connect your calendar.
usecases.p.1: It takes the enquiry, asks for what is missing and hands you the close.
usecases.p.2: Order status, how-to and troubleshooting without anyone opening an email.
usecases.p.3: When someone asks about an order, it checks your system and replies with the current status.
usecases.p.4: It answers questions about appointments, payments or missing documents according to the flow you approved.
usecases.p.5: Hours, location, prices and payment methods: the ones you are always asked, answered during the hours you choose.
